newsitem.title: USA: Primark expands credit, completes WEFA buy.
newsitem.headline: Primark expands credit, completes WEFA buy.

text.p: Primark Corp said on Friday it refinanced its $208 million credit facilities with Mellon Bank, and added $100 million of term debt.
Primark also completed its purchase of WEFA Holdings Inc, and named Allen Sinai WEFA's chief economist.

Primark now has $308.4 million in financing available under the new agreements, including a $75 million revolving credit facility, a $225 term loan and an $8.4 million line of credit. The company said the financing would fund some recent acquisitions and provide capacity for future growth.

Primark bought WEFA from Bain Capital Inc and certain other stockholders for $45 million in cash. Sinai, who moved to Primark from Lehman Bros Holdings Inc last fall, assumes his new duties at WEFA immediately.
